lines.t: I have written it on tablets of stone, and within the heart of man, and within the pages of my book it is made plain.
Thus, they are without excuse, for I am God alone, the righteous one.
I alone am holy, just, and good.
I alone have divided right from wrong I alone have established the law and define what is sin
behold I expose the darkness and bring all hidden things into the light for I alone sit as judge the
the only faithful and true witness, says the Lord.
